menu_options.tuya_core: Tuya lights from the built-in Tuya integration
menu_options.tuya_cloud: Tuya lights from my Tuya / Smart Life account

chroma.title: Razer Chroma
chroma.description: IP address of the Windows PC running Razer Synapse with the Chroma SDK. See README for exposing port 54235 on the LAN.

tuya.title: Tuya light
tuya.description: Local control of a Tuya bulb / LED strip. Device ID and local key can be obtained with `python -m tinytuya wizard`.

tuya_cloud.title: Tuya / Smart Life account
tuya_cloud.description:
Open the Smart Life (or Tuya Smart) app → Me → ⚙ Settings → Account and Security → User Code, and enter that code here. The account is only used to read device keys; lights are then controlled locally.

{error}

tuya_scan.title: Scan the QR code
tuya_scan.description:
Scan this QR code with the Smart Life / Tuya Smart app (scan icon in the top right corner), confirm the login in the app, then press Submit.

{error}

tuya_pick.title: Choose devices
tuya_pick.description: Found {total} devices on the account, {found} of them on the local network. Lights are preselected.

tuya_ips.title: IP addresses
tuya_ips.description: {count} selected device(s) were not found on the local network (they may be offline, or Home Assistant does not receive UDP broadcasts). Enter their IP addresses, or leave empty to skip.

abort.no_new_devices: No new devices: all devices of this account are already added
abort.no_devices_added: No device was added (missing IP addresses)

init.title: Sync
init.description: Optionally pick a light whose color and brightness these lights will mirror (e.g. a Tuya bulb for Razer Chroma).
